Turning the corner, shifting into higher gear; PT up, BUY.Positive results in 2024.AUTO1 Group published its annual report 2024, achieving its first full-year net profit since going public.
1:
Group revenue rose by 15% yoy to EUR 
6.27bn, while gross profit increased by 37% to EUR 724.7m.Adjusted EBITDA came in at EUR 109.2m, a significant turnaround from EUR -43.9m in the prior year.Net income reached EUR 20.9m, compared to a loss of EUR 116.5m in 2023.Strong growth across the board.In the Merchant segment, AUTO1 sold 615,335 vehicles, representing growth of 17.7%.Segment revenue rose to EUR 5.04bn, and gross profit reached EUR 562.6m.Gross profit per unit (GPU) increased to EUR 914, up 14% from the previous year, supported by logistics efficiency and sourcing scale.In the Retail segment, Autohero sold 74,438 vehicles, an increase of 18%.Revenue rose to EUR 1.23bn, and gross profit reached EUR 162.1m.GPU improved by 26% to 
EUR 2,163, driven by pricing precision, operational efficiency, and expanded financing.FY25 outlook.For 2025, AUTO1 is guiding for continued growth and incremental margin improvement.The company expects to sell between 735k-795k vehicles, including 650k to 700k in the Merchant segment and 85k to 95k in Retail.Gross profit is forecast to reach EUR 800m to EUR 875m.Adjusted EBITDA is expected between 
EUR 135m and EUR 165m, translating to a margin of around 2.2% to 2.6%.The outlook is supported by early signs of used car market stabilization.The AUTO1 Price Index rose by 2.7% in the first quarter of 2025, with a 1.1% yoy increase in March.In our view, this environment reduces pricing risk and supports GPU visibility across both segments.Conclusion.2024 was a turning point for AUTO1.The group achieved profitability and delivered improvements in scale, efficiency, and customer economics.With conservative guidance and a more stable market backdrop, 2025 is expected to bring further incremental gains.We have increased our profitability estimates and reworked our working capital projection, leading overall to a revised PT of EUR 27.00 (old: EUR 
25.00).We maintain our BUY recommendation.

Due to the fact that companies rarely bear sufficient resemblance to peers in terms of geographical exposure, size or competitive strength and in order to adjust for the pitfalls of weak long-term visibility, an Adjusted Free Cash Flow analysis (Adjusted 
FCF) has been conducted.

A peer group or comparable company (“comps”) analysis is a methodology that calculates a company's relative value — how much it should be worth based on how it compares to other similar companies.Given that AUTO1 Group SE differs quite significantly in terms of size, focus, financial health and growth trajectory, we regard our peer group analysis merely as a support for other valuation methods.The peer group of AUTO1 Group SE consists of the stocks displayed in the chart below.As of

Risk 
The chart displays the distribution of daily returns of AUTO1 Group SE over the last 
3 years, compared to the same distribution for Kamux Oyj.We have also included the distribution for the index Germany MDAX.The distribution gives a better understanding of risk than measures like volatility, which assume that log returns are normally distributed.In reality, they are skewed (down moves are larger) and have fat tails (large moves occur more often than predicted).Also, volatility treats up and down moves the same, while investors are more worried about down moves.For AUTO1 Group SE, the worst day during the past 3 years was 19/01/2023 with a share price decline of -14.2%.The best day was 08/05/2024 when the share price increased by 28.3%.
